Scale: the plate looks like a side plate of about 20 cm, so its rim spans roughly 480 px and 1 px is about 0.042 cm.

Sausage: about 10 slices, each roughly 3 cm across and 1 cm thick. That is about 7 cm³ per slice, or about 7 g, so about 70 g in total. Some pieces are smaller, so I lower this to about 60 g.

Almonds: I count about 28. Each weighs about 1.2 g, which gives about 34 g.

Grapes: there are 9, mostly red and one green. Each weighs about 5 g, which gives about 45 g.
